card.name: Start of pent-, tet-, hex- drug terms
card.fires_on: A fragment that begins or sits inside a long drug or chemical name whose next piece is a numeric prefix such as pent-, tet- or hex-. Seen in tetrabenazine, pemetrexed, docosahexaenoic acid and perfluorohexyloctane.

modes.label: Opening letter of a drug name
modes.description: A single letter such as t or p starts a name like tetrabenazine or pemetrexed after 'dose of' or 'infuse'.
modes.example: The dose of<< t>>etrabenazine tablets should be individualized

modes.label: Inside hexa- chemical names
modes.description: A short piece inside a fatty acid or fluorinated compound name right before hex.

card.plain: It fires on the broken-up start of long drug names that continue with pent, tet or hex.
